note: Initial encoding of the context-based selection framework (report Section 4.6). Weights range from -3 (strongly unsuited) to +3 (strongly suited) and must be recalibrated against the findings in Chapter 4 before the final evaluation.

plan_driven.label: Plan-driven (Waterfall / V-Model)
plan_driven.rationale: Home ground: stable requirements, larger teams, high assurance and documentation needs.

scrum.label: Scrum
scrum.rationale: Iterative delivery for small teams facing changing requirements.

kanban.label: Kanban
kanban.rationale: Continuous flow with work-in-progress limits; suited to unpredictable, steady demand.

agile_devops.label: Agile with DevOps (CI/CD)
agile_devops.rationale: Frequent releases with automated build, test and deployment; demands technical maturity.

hybrid.label: Defined hybrid (phase gates + iterations)
hybrid.rationale: Plan-driven governance with iterative delivery inside phases; suited to larger or regulated settings.

caveats.message: Team agile maturity is low: plan training and coaching before and during adoption (Dikert et al., 2016).
Strict regulation: add explicit documentation and approval gates to the iterative process.
Large team: a single-team framework needs added cross-team coordination (Dikert et al., 2016; Edison et al., 2022).
High requirement volatility: late changes are costly in a sequential process; add prototyping and iterative testing (Boehm, 2002).
